mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, stock_code, short_count, short_sold_count, not_sold_count, borrow_price, borrow_base_total, create_game_date, create_game_time FROM user_short_position WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, stock_code, short_count, short_sold_count, not_sold_count, borrow_price, borrow_base_total, create_game_date, create_game_time FROM user_short_position WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY stock_code
mapper.update: UPDATE user_short_position SET short_count = #{shortCount}, short_sold_count = #{shortSoldCount}, not_sold_count = #{notSoldCount}, borrow_price = #{borrowPrice}, borrow_base_total = #{borrowBaseTotal} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_short_position WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode}
